derivation: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H681 (אֵצֶל) with the article interposed; house of the side;

occurrences.text: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth–ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
